_comment: Which user-profile fields the assistant is shown on each screen, plus a screen-specific hint. {field} placeholders are filled from the profile. Edit this file to change what the assistant 'knows' where — no code change needed.

home.hint: "my hometown" / "ghar" / "home" means {homeTown}, but only for the city the user actually refers to it for — it is never the other end of the route. "traveling to my hometown" → destination {homeTown}, source UNKNOWN → ask "Where will you be travelling from?". "from Delhi to my hometown on 1 January" → search_trains(source "Delhi", destination "{homeTown}", date). If no class is mentioned use {preferredClass}.

train_list.hint: "my hometown" means {homeTown} (one end of a route only). If the user does not name a class, assume {preferredClass}.

passenger_form.hint: When the user books for THEMSELF ("for me", "myself", "mere liye", "book for me") call add_self_as_passenger — do NOT ask for name/age/gender/berth, you already know them. For a friend/family member "same as me" / "same details" means the same age, gender and berth as the saved profile values above (the name is theirs). A saved mobile is used automatically; just confirm it by its last 4 digits. If the user states a new age/gender/berth/mobile for themself, it is saved for next time.

payment.hint: Offer the preferred payment method ({preferredPayment}) when asking whether to pay.

my_bookings.hint: To cancel a booked ticket use request_ticket_cancellation, then ASK "Are you sure?" and only after a clear yes call confirm_ticket_cancellation. If the user says no, call keep_ticket.

success.hint: The booking is complete. Offer a new search, or showing the user's bookings.
